_comment: Scripted model answers for the offline tests. They stand in for the provider so no request leaves the process; they are NOT output from a real model and say nothing about real model accuracy. `good` answers were written by hand to describe the implementation; `bad` answers reproduce failure modes RepoLens must catch.

notes_app/auth.py.summary: Implements password hashing, signed expiring session tokens, and an in-process session registry used to authenticate users.
notes_app/auth.py.purpose: Authentication helpers: hash and verify passwords, issue and validate HMAC-signed tokens, and track active sessions.
responsibilities: Hashes passwords with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 and a random salt, storing them as salt$digest.
Verifies a password by re-hashing it with the stored salt and comparing in constant time.
Issues tokens of the form user:expiry:signature signed with HMAC-SHA256 using `TOKEN_SECRET`.
Validates tokens by checking the signature and rejecting expired ones.
Starts and ends sessions in the module-level `_sessions` dict and resolves the current user from a token.

keySymbols.name: hash_password
keySymbols.description: Salted PBKDF2 password hash.

keySymbols.name: issue_token
keySymbols.description: Creates an HMAC-signed token that expires after `SESSION_TTL_SECONDS`.

keySymbols.name: validate_token
keySymbols.description: Returns the user id for a well-signed, unexpired token, else None.

keySymbols.name: start_session
keySymbols.description: Issues a token and records it as an active session.

keySymbols.name: current_user
keySymbols.description: Resolves a token to a user only if it is an active, valid session.

dependencies.description: Reads the token secret and session lifetime.
The service layer uses it for login and access checks.

uncertainties: Sessions live only in process memory, so they are lost on restart and not shared between processes.

notes_app/cache.py.summary: Caches rendered note text as files under `.notes-cache`, ignores entries older than ten minutes, and deletes every cached file on purge.
notes_app/cache.py.purpose: A disk-backed cache for rendered notes, despite docstrings that describe it as in-memory.
responsibilities: Writes text to a file named after the key in the `CACHE_DIR` directory, creating it if needed.
Reads a cached file back unless it is missing or older than `MAX_AGE_SECONDS` (600 seconds).
Removes every file in the cache directory when `purge` is called.

keySymbols.name: remember
keySymbols.description: Writes the text to a cache file.

keySymbols.name: recall
keySymbols.description: Reads a cache file if it is fresh enough.

keySymbols.name: purge
keySymbols.description: Deletes all cache files.

dependencies.description: The service caches rendered notes and purges after adding one.

sideEffects.description: Creates the cache directory and writes cache files.
Deletes every file in the cache directory.

uncertainties: The module docstring says nothing is written to disk and the `purge` docstring says it does nothing, but the code writes and deletes files; the docstrings contradict the implementation.

notes_app/storage.py.summary: Stores notes in a SQLite table and can export one owner's notes to a JSON file.
notes_app/storage.py.purpose: The persistence layer for notes, wrapping a single SQLite connection in `NoteStore`.
responsibilities: Opens the SQLite database and creates the notes table if missing.
Inserts a note, commits, and returns its row id.
Lists an owner's note bodies in insertion order.
Exports an owner's notes as a JSON list to a file.

keySymbols.name: NoteStore
keySymbols.description: Owns the SQLite connection for notes.

keySymbols.name: NoteStore.add
keySymbols.description: Inserts and commits one note.

keySymbols.name: NoteStore.export
keySymbols.description: Writes notes to a JSON file.

notes_app/sync.py.summary: Asynchronously pushes each owner's notes to a remote sync URL with httpx, concurrently for several owners.
notes_app/sync.py.purpose: Uploads locally stored notes to the configured sync service.
responsibilities: Loads an owner's notes from `NoteStore`.
POSTs them as JSON to `SYNC_URL` and raises on an HTTP error status.
Closes the HTTP client it created itself.
Pushes several owners concurrently with asyncio.gather and returns counts per owner.

keySymbols.name: push_notes
keySymbols.description: Async upload of one owner's notes.

keySymbols.name: push_all
keySymbols.description: Runs push_notes for many owners concurrently.

sideEffects.description: HTTP POST of the notes to the sync URL.

uncertainties: What the remote sync service does with the notes is not visible in this file.

notes_app/service.py.summary: Defines `NotesService`, which handles login, adding notes, and rendering a user's notes with caching.
notes_app/service.py.purpose: The application service layer that combines authentication, storage, and the render cache.
responsibilities: Logs a user in by verifying the password and starting a session.
Adds a note for the signed-in user and purges the render cache.
Renders a user's notes, serving the cached text when available and caching fresh text otherwise.
Rejects unauthenticated calls with PermissionError.

keySymbols.description: Use cases for the HTTP layer.

keySymbols.name: NotesService.add_note
keySymbols.description: Stores a note and purges the cache.

keySymbols.name: NotesService.render_notes
keySymbols.description: Returns cached or freshly joined note text.

uncertainties: Side effects happen in the modules it calls (storage and cache), not in this file directly.

responsibilities: Capitalizes the first letter of each word in `title_case`.
